headline: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed
summary: Two Israeli soldiers died in an explosion during a sweep; retaliatory strikes hit Tibnin, killing one person and wounding 12, as Rome talks continued.
script: Israel has carried out strikes on southern Lebanon after two of its soldiers were killed by an explosion. Lebanese authorities say at least one person died in the strikes, which came as the two countries held talks in Rome.
imageAlt: The aftermath of an Israeli strike in southern Lebanon shows a cratered, debris-covered field.
imageAltTwo: Smoke rises over a hillside village in southern Lebanon after Israeli strikes.
